notes: Zones are put back after a restart also when a preset is applied at start-up; the app shows whether the saved zones were put back
ESP32-C3: 3 or 4 LED outputs all sent together over SPI (no more frozen LEDs with Bluetooth); zones kept after a restart. (v96 was too big for the ESP32-C3 and could not be installed.)
LED outputs: a button or movement sensor on an LED pin is moved off it (GPIO 0), one output that cannot start no longer stops the others, and the app says which pin is taken
